notes.title: Rejuvan Update v0.8 - Tutorial, Visual and Chat Update!
notes.content:
THIS UPDATE IS FAIRLY LARGE

Welcome to Rejuvan v0.8!

I. Tutorial

When creating a new slot, players have the option to choose whether or not to play the tutorial.
The tutorial includes progression up to the Old Ore Heater, with indicators and useful hints as to what to do.
Aside from that, the Module Factory has been given a new context button in the inventory - "Learn"
By pressing this button, the player is instructed about the Module Factory and what it does, along with a short tutorial for it specifically.
This feature can be easily implemented for any other building (if suggested)

II. Visual

The motion blur can now be turned off!
The colors look a lot more vibrant. The weather is more representative. A theme song will play when it is sunny or cloudy, respectively. I added more post-processing effects.

III. Chat

By pressing T you can open the chat. Any player can type in the chat and it is replicated to all clients. By typing "/help" you get insight on all commands.

Commands that start with "/" can be run on any map.
Commands that start with "!" can be run on creative maps.

And yes, you can play the game in creative.

I'll let you discover what command I have added so have fun.

IV. Others

I also added 3 new crates that can be found on the volcano. One gives a volcanic-tier item called "FlamsCreation"

notes.title: Rejuvan Patch v0.7 - Environment, Fixes and Custom Data!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 🌱

We’ve been hard at work on the latest update, and we’re super excited to share Rejuvan Patch v0.7 with you all. This one’s packed with some fresh new content, bug fixes (thank you Discord fam for all the reports!), and a brand-new feature to save your custom item data. Here’s a breakdown of what’s new:

🌿 Environment Overhaul

Added water foam to rivers, lakes, and the ocean, making the water look way more alive and immersive!
We've planted more foliage and trees around the map to make the world feel even richer and more vibrant.


🔧 Bug Fixes

All bugs reported in the Discord have been squashed. Seriously, thank you to everyone who helped spot these. Keep them coming!


🛠️ Custom Data Saving

You can now save custom item data, meaning all the unique items you've tweaked or created will stick around, even after closing the game. We hope this gives you more freedom in crafting your perfect experience!
As always, let us know what you think in the discussions or on Discord. Your feedback means the world to me!

notes.title: Rejuvan Patch v0.5.3
notes.content:
This is a small update with some pretty big implications.

I. Backpack

You may now pick up ores from the ground and put them in your backpack. While in the backpack, ores can be thoroughly inspected and analyzed, seeing almost all stats related to them.
The backpack can be opened from the menus.

II. UI Changes

After seeing too many people struggle with finding the quests menu, I moved all menus in the main menu found by pressing ESC.

III. Casual bug fixes

- Finally solved the shop duplication bug
- Fixed the money notification showing your current amount instead of the gained amount
- Shop locks no longer appear on previously unlocked items

UNFIXED KNOWN ISSUES:

- Client conveyors are moving in the wrong directions
- Probing data doesn't save on quit


Thank you for reading this

notes.title: The Multiplayer Update is here!
notes.content:
DISCLAIMER: SAVE FILES MADE BEFORE THIS UPDATE MAY BE CORRUPTED DUE TO FRAMEWORK REDESIGN. THIS WILL PROBABLY NEVER HAPPEN AGAIN

I had to make this update because people were complaining about getting bored quickly from just making their factories.

Because of that, I made a lot of changes to a few different fields:

I. Multiplayer

- Players can host and join non-dedicated servers using steam's multiplayer services. Joining/Hosting is currently available only in the main menu (for now)
- All players share the same inventory, stats and plot
- Above each player character, there now exists a nametag, indicating their Steam name
- As of my knowledge, everything works as it used to be before this update, with a few small improvements to performance

II. Exploration

- Besides the main island, there are now 3 more islands to explore, each containing unique things to learn and explore
- Most islands contain Crates. These are one-time openable treasures that contain items and money for people that prefer adventuring, rather than mining
- If, by any means, a player gets stuck by accidentally selling their starter items (not including their furnace), they may now find coconuts and golden coconuts scoured in some areas that are shaded by trees, Coconuts count as ores, but they do not increase the base's heat

III. Movement

- Players now jump higher and they can now control their characters mid-air
- Swimming is now a mechanic
- Being underwater distorts hearing and vision

IV. Other tweaks and fixes

- The building schematics now use dithered transparency for both visual and performance increases
- Fixed a bug in which the Ore Teleporter Shipper would not teleport the ores to the right location
- Fixed the main character's skin looking metallic
- Made lighting and weather effects more realistic
- Music should now loop during the corresponding weather events


Thank you for reading this far! If you haven't already, be sure to join the Official Rejuvan Discord server if you desire to report any bugs or glitches you might encounter while playing after this new update.
